verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is itself an official first-party SDK (Python and JS) with extensive documented primitives (agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, streaming, sessions, tracing, MCP support, multi-provider model support) plus community corroboration of real usage. missing for 10: independent third-party audits of API stability/versioning guarantees and broader cross-language SDK coverage beyond Python/JS.
